narrative.overview: The page is a Googie roadside diner serving a movie-night shortlist: the ranked catalog reads as a menu board, votes are punched tickets, and the starburst sign is the liveliest object on the page. It refuses the dark streaming-grid landing page — no near-black hero, no gradient badges, no Inter. Instead: warm counter laminate, chrome trim, turquoise and coral, and a neon starburst reserved for the moment you vote. Density is moderate and playful. The hero carries the swoop (a cantilever chrome band that tilts into a vertical spine on phones), the board is a simple responsive grid, and motion is scarce and purposeful — a slow sign spin, a neon flicker, an ease-out card entrance. The world's job is to make voting feel like ordering the special.
keyCharacteristics: Two saturated counter colors (turquoise, coral) carry all surface color; everything else is warm laminate and chrome.
The starburst is the signature: rank plates, vote buttons, and the hero sign all snap into it when active.
Slab caps for titles, script for feature names — a menu, not a dashboard.
All ink is tinted; there is no pure black or gray anywhere.

rules.name: The Two-Color Rule
rules.body: Turquoise and coral are the only saturated hues. Any third competing color must earn its place or be removed.

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: Never pure black or pure gray. Charcoal is blue-tinted (#2e3538); every neutral carries a cast.

rules.name: The Slab Rule
rules.body: Anything that announces (titles, CTAs, badges) is slab caps. Script never carries action; it only entices.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows appear only as hover lifts and the modal. No permanent drop-shadow clutter.

rules.name: The No-Bounce Rule
rules.body: All motion uses cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Bounce and elastic easing are banned.

dos: Do reserve neon white for active states and the booth bar — it is the reward for voting.
Do put every score inside a badge, every rank inside a starburst, and every vote inside the orbit arc.
Do keep ink tinted (#2e3538 base) — warm the charcoal, never go pure black.
Do use the ease-out cubic (cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)) for all motion.
donts: Don't add a third saturated color, gradients beyond the two-tone turquoise, or glass effects.
Don't wrap cards in cards, or stack chrome frames inside chrome frames.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing — the world is retro, not bouncy.
Don't put action text in script — script entices, slab acts.
Don't use Inter, system defaults, or a purple-to-blue gradient anywhere.
